question_text: Two light rays of red and blue colour are made to pass separately through a glass prism of refracting angle $60^\circ$. If both rays suffer minimum deviation while passing the prism, which of the following relations between the refractive indices ($\mu_r$) of red and ($\mu_b$) of blue is correct? Given that the angle of incidence of the red ray ($i_r$) is $30^\circ$ and the angle of refraction of the blue ray ($r_b$) at the surface of incidence of the prism is $30^\circ$
